board_followup.pop_outline: Module2144 PieceOutlines fn12339 draws only piece.locked && !piece.tutLock. Normal add-piece fn18084 leaves locked absent, so ordinary cell-pop has no black/white contour. Pen locked contour is a fixed whole-piece SVG path; dash draw is independent of individual cell-pop. Victory fn12340 draws gold over all pieces.
board_followup.pen_order: SetPenTrace(cells,0) can precede TryPlace; new matching PieceStyle waits for SetPenTrace progress>=1 before 45ms/230ms cell pop. SetPenTrace(null,1) finishes and clears trace.
board_followup.rounded_fill: CellPolygon rounds only corners with both adjacent neighbours absent; every cell remains a convex polygon. Pop scales those vertices around each cell centre and inverse-scales UV. Win shine uses ClipConvex against the same polygons.
board_followup.symbols: Star, heart cubic, diamond, ring (hole), flower and wall =/x are geometric SVG-ratio graphics; concave icon fill uses ear clipping, avoiding whole-piece concave triangle fans.
